# Bundled fonts

`app/src/main/res/font/` holds IBM Plex Sans (regular, medium, semibold) and IBM Plex Mono (regular,
medium), the typeface of the agreed design (prototype/styles.css, typeface A). They are bundled in
the app, never downloaded: the app has no internet permission.

Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (the two OFL files here), compatible with the project's
GPL-3.0-or-later. Source: the IBM Plex project, as served by Google Fonts (TrueType).
